title: Real-time Chat E2E Test Suite
tech: Playwright, TypeScript, axe-core, GitHub Actions, Allure
description: The Playwright suite that lives in the We Communicate repo and runs against the live app after every push to main.
features: Auth: login validation (missing, malformed, and wrong credentials, and offline), forgot-password and sign-up OTP flows, and route guards for logged-out users and fake tokens
Messaging: send, receive, and delete, file uploads, safe link rendering, replies, search, and drafts that survive a refresh
Two logged-in browsers for live checks: read receipts and the unread divider, typing, presence, unread notification counts, and blocking
Voice messages recorded with a fake microphone, call buttons on 1:1 vs group chats, and disappearing-message settings
PWA share target (POST, Samsung GET, logged-out redirects), offline queueing, and dark mode contrast checked with axe-core
Page Object Model behind a POManager fixture. GitHub Actions waits for the Render deploy, runs the suite, and publishes the Allure report to GitHub Pages
challenges: Offline. The tests cut the network with context.setOffline, then send, delete, clear history, or delete a conversation. Those actions go into the app's queue. To reconnect, a helper posts SYNC_QUEUE to the service worker and waits for its MESSAGE_SYNCED reply, then waits for the pending indicator to clear. The clear-history test checks that a message queued before the clear stays gone after the queue replays and the page reloads, and that a message sent after it survives.

title: Hybrid Selenium Automation Framework
tech: Selenium, Java, TestNG, Maven, Jenkins, Extent Reports
description: Scalable Selenium automation framework using Page Object Model with CI integration for regression testing.
challenges: Ensuring thread-safe execution during parallel runs and maintaining readable test reports as the test suite scaled.

title: REST Assured API Testing Framework
tech: REST Assured, Cucumber, Java, Maven, GitHub Actions
description: BDD-driven API testing framework for Google Maps-style Place API with complete CRUD operation coverage and automated reporting.
features: Cucumber HTML reporting with Maven plugin
challenges: Managing test data across multiple scenarios while maintaining test independence. Implemented hooks for setup/teardown and static place_id management to ensure clean state between tests.
